criteria.label: Geology: hematite, high-Ca pyroxene, olivine + exposed strata
Novelty (distance from the Curiosity traverse, full at 1 km)
Sample diversity: clay, sulfate, hematite within 100 m

overlay.note: same placement as minerals.png: covers_m from the area's north-west corner

reach.calibration: route.json과 비교: 산소 ×1.000, 시간 ×1.000 (1에 가까우면 pipeline과 일치)

formula: V = S x R; S = weighted mean of criterion scores (0-1); R = 1 - 0.5 * roundtrip_O2 / limit, 0 if over limit, blocked, protected or over max EVA time
notes: Criterion scores are normalised within this area (2nd-98th percentile), so they rank sites relative to each other, not on an absolute scale.
Round-trip O2 uses the steepest local slope, so it is conservative.
THEMIS thermal inertia is 100 m/px and only reflects broad trends.
Novelty = distance from the Curiosity traverse, not from sampled targets.

bins.science.bin: Uint8 [criteria x meshH x meshW], 0-254 = score 0-1, 255 = no data, criteria in the order of "criteria"
bins.reach.bin: Uint8 [meshH x meshW], R x 254 (0 = cannot reach)

web.site_rule: a site must score >= 0.6 (science.py high_score) in every picked objective; ranked by mean(picked scores) x R; sites >= 150 m apart

gale_mapping.resource: max(SINDEX2, BD2100_2, BD1900R2) x THEMIS firm ground
gale_mapping.novelty: distance from the Curiosity traverse / 1 km, capped at 1 (full from 1 km on)
gale_mapping.diversity: share of the clay (D2300, BD2290) / sulfate (SINDEX2, BD2100_2) / hematite (BD860_2, BD530_2) families scoring >= 0.6 within 100 m

excluded.BD2230: hydroxylated ferric sulfate, low confidence: strong cells form vertical stripes (column/row anisotropy 3.15 vs ~1.0 for the other water indices) and 74% of the old Water-strong area came from it alone; still shown in the CRISM mineral overlay, not used for scores
